name: Retrospective decision-tolerance diagnostic of frozen shared precision policies
stage: Protocol fixed before this diagnostic's epsilon outcomes are computed.
scope: Private isolated probe; no main manuscript changes, refitting, new policy optimization, or policy selection from evaluation answers.

cohort.unit: six-hour block; six paired contrasts sharing four models and one two-reading policy

information_model: Uncapped nonnegative hourly allocations with exact retained endpoints and exact queried cumulative readings. Forecast contrasts and query policies are frozen.

thresholds.formula: epsilon = factor * preexisting system training second moment M2
thresholds.units: squared kWh; six-target mean squared loss
thresholds.status: Retrospective sensitivity target; not operationally calibrated.

outcomes.epsilon_best: A model m is certified epsilon-optimal iff upper(loss_m-loss_j)<=epsilon for every j!=m. Reversed pair uses -lower. Select lexicographically if multiple qualify.
outcomes.strict_best: Separately use upper(loss_m-loss_j)<0 for every j!=m; reconcile existing 123/207 adaptive,118/208 greedy,122/201 fixed counts.
outcomes.upper_regret: max(0, upper(loss_m-loss_j) over j!=m); report minimum across models with lexicographic ties.
outcomes.actual_record: Check every claimed certificate against the exact stored affine contrast at the actual source record; retain any numerical model-loss representation limitations.
outcomes.randomized: Compute expected decision success across every saved batch outcome. Convert binary64 weights to exact rationals, clip only negative roundoff >=-1e-12 and normalize to unit mass; report maximum correction. Do not optimize weights.

replay: Reconstruct each adaptive/greedy second query from the saved conditional lines and the first queried prefix answer using the original 1e-12 tie convention. Require equality with the saved ledger.
summaries: all seven factors for each source

uncertainty.method: Descriptive synchronized seven-day circular calendar-block percentile bootstrap,2000 draws, within each source; all intraday blocks and systems share day indices.
uncertainty.interpretation: Repeated blocks are not independent systems; no population inference or threshold optimization.

verification: Independent checker must not import the producer or its bound helper. Rebind inputs, independently reconstruct all pairwise decisions and summaries, verify exact endpoint vertices on first/middle/last block of every system, check source truth validity, and reconcile strict winners.
